summary: DeepSeek presents DeepSeek-V2, a new 236B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 21B activated parameters and 128K context, using Multi-head Latent Attention and DeepSeekMoE to cut training cost and KV-cache memory while boosting throughput versus its prior DeepSeek 67B model.

mechanisms.reason: The paper states a specific architectural technique (MLA) that compresses KV cache and a stated large reduction in cache size and boost in throughput, directly lowering compute/memory work per token.
mechanisms.quote: reduces the KV cache by 93.3%, and boosts the maximum generation throughput to 5.76 times

mechanisms.reason: The model is reported to require substantially less training cost than its predecessor for comparable or better capability, working against rising training compute demand.
mechanisms.quote: DeepSeek-V2 achieves significantly stronger performance, and meanwhile saves 42.5% of training costs

mechanisms.reason: A longer 128K context window would normally raise per-accelerator memory content, but the paper states the accompanying KV-cache compression sharply cuts that same footprint.
mechanisms.quote: supports a context length of 128K tokens ... MLA guarantees efficient inference through significantly compressing the Key-Value (KV) cache into a latent vector

categories.reason: A stated 93.3% reduction in KV cache size lowers the memory footprint a serving system needs per model instance, reducing pressure on memory hardware demand for this workload.

practices.reason: The model offers a much longer context window, lower training cost, and higher throughput than its predecessor, which a team could evaluate for adoption if it needs those specific gains.
practices.quote: DeepSeek-V2 adopts innovative architectures including Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE ... reduces the KV cache by 93.3%, and boosts the maximum generation throughput to 5.76 times

practices.reason: MLA's KV-cache compression is a concrete architectural technique with a stated large memory reduction, but it is tied to this specific model architecture rather than a drop-in serving trick.
practices.quote: MLA guarantees efficient inference through significantly compressing the Key-Value (KV) cache into a latent vector

notable_reason: DeepSeek-V2 discloses concrete architecture-level efficiency figures (KV cache -93.3%, throughput 5.76x, training cost -42.5%) that are directly relevant to inference cost and memory demand assessments.
